newsitem.title: UK: KEPIT slams TREG level of acceptances.
newsitem.headline: KEPIT slams TREG level of acceptances.

text.p: Kleinwort European Privatisation Investment Trust Plc (KEPIT) said the acceptance level achieved by predator TR European Growth Trust Plc (TREG) for its offer so far was "dismal."
In a statement, KEPIT chairman Shane Ross said KEPIT investors "seem quite clear that it is their independent directors who are acting in their interests."
Earlier, TREG said it had received acceptances equivalent to 2.8 percent of KEPIT ordinary shares and to 2.3 percent of issued warrants by 1400 GMT on September 13.
TREG's offer has been extended to October 4.
It is offering 103.1 pence for shares and warrants if holders opt for cash or the equivalent of 107.6 pence if they choose to take TR European shares.
KEPIT said it was working on a circular which would enable full details of the independent directors' proposals to be sent to shareholders and warrant holders later this month.
